entities.summary: Tahyna Tozzi (b. 1986-04-24, Cronulla) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cronulla and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, architects & designers, oceania.
